 Which checks should run before
 project-a is released?

   1. [✔] Unit tests
          Run the unit tests under test/
          against src/app.ts
 ❯ 2. [ ] Type check
          Run the TypeScript compiler
          with no emit, so a type error
          stops the release
   3. [ ] Lint
          Run the linter over src/ and
          test/ with the project's own
          rules
   4. [ ] Build
          Build project-a into dist/ and
          keep the build report beside
          it
   5. [ ] Type something
      Submit
──
   6. Chat about this
